notes: Conversational Vaulty: ask naturally and Vaulty answers like a person — researched first, in prose. Power asks ("best Octavia Prime build, kills anything, survival and destroying everything") now get a full Workshop dossier instead of the stock card: a named concept ("Room Melter"), how it destroys and survives, the full layout with a why for every mod, a Helminth pick with reasoning, two arcanes, an Archon Shard setup, a why-it-works math section computed from the build itself (no made-up numbers), a play rotation, and a follow-up offer. General questions are dug up live — guide, live game data, the Warframe Wiki and the pages it links to — cross-checked, then answered in plain prose with sources. Follow-ups resolve too: after an Octavia answer, "and for steel path survival?" just works.
